{{Top|leg}}
The '''Smuggling Interdiction Division''' was a branch of the [[Corellian Security Force]] dealing with [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and contraband.<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

Corsec officers [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] served there with [[Kirtan Loor]] as the division's [[Imperial Liaison]].<ref name="KT" />
